purpose: Test the complete eligible-parent distribution under the already locked primary configuration before running the larger Phase B robustness grid.
status_before_execution: The Phase A universal-harm headline is withdrawn. No all-parent T2 result on final seeds has been inspected.

fixed_conditions.per_example_quality_relation: Every alias must have exactly the parent's frozen per-example oracle vector.
fixed_conditions.budget_policy: Use each task's locked primary budget.
fixed_conditions.temperature_policy: Use the task-specific proxy-selected temperature already recorded in Phase A; no retuning.
fixed_conditions.pool_policy: Use the same deterministic pool generator and pool size as Phase A.
fixed_conditions.target_population: Every parent for which the frozen wrapper constructor has at least the required number of parent-wrong positions with an observed alternative wrong response.

selection_partition.role: Development-only target selection; no confidence claim.
selection_partition.selection_rule: Within each task, select the eligible parent with the largest mean paired delta in cumulative fixed-universe deployed-output regret. Exact ties choose the smaller frozen model index.

confirmation_partition.disclosure: These seeds were used in Phase A for one pre-fixed top-quality parent, but complete all-parent T2 effects have not been computed or inspected. Development selection cannot use any Phase A outcome.
confirmation_partition.reporting: Report every eligible parent, including negative and beneficial effects.

statistics.primary_endpoint: Paired delta in cumulative fixed-universe deployed-output regret.
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg within each task across the complete eligible-parent audit.
Benjamini-Hochberg across the three independently development-selected confirmation targets.
distributional_reporting: minimum, quartiles, median, maximum of final-seed target-level mean effects
fractions with positive, negative, and zero point estimates
counts with positive or negative bootstrap intervals
counts significant after within-task BH correction

binding_gate.B1_harmful_tail_confirmation: PASS only if the development-selected target has a positive final-seed mean, a strictly positive bootstrap lower bound, and BH-adjusted p below 0.05 in all three tasks.
binding_gate.if_pass: Proceed to Phase B2 matched-distance temperature/distance/alias robustness and defense frontier. This is not yet a paper GO.
binding_gate.if_fail: Final topic NO-GO. Do not select a replacement target on final seeds and do not use the larger robustness grid to rescue the harmful-attack claim.
forbidden_rescues: Replacing the development-selected parent with the most harmful final-seed parent.
Changing a task's primary temperature after observing B1.
Dropping OpenBookQA or another negative task.
Claiming path redirection alone establishes harmful manipulation.
Comparing a 5 percent attack with defense cost at a larger unmatched radius.
